title: Quaint Russian Bread Flatbread
description: A yeasty, crisp, romantic flatbread that balances the earthy flavor of celery salt with the buttery touch of beurre-monte, perfect for a paleo-friendly gathering.
instructions: In a bowl, combine buckwheat flour, almond flour, and celery salt.
Sprinkle yeast over warm water and stir until dissolved.
Pour the yeast mixture into the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for 5 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover, and let rise for 45 minutes until doubled in size.
Punch down the dough, divide it into four equal portions, and roll each into a flat circle about 1 inch thick.
Preheat a dry skillet over medium-high heat and brush with olive oil.
Cook each flatbread for 3 minutes on each side until crisp and golden, brushing with beurre-monte on the second side.
